entries.name: Attack
entries.text: Make one melee or ranged attack. Some features (like Extra Attack) allow more than one attack with this action.

entries.name: Cast a Spell
entries.text: Cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action. You can't cast a leveled spell as an action and a bonus-action spell on the same turn (cantrips with a casting time of 1 action are fine).

entries.name: Dash
entries.text: Gain extra movement equal to your speed for the current turn, after applying modifiers.

entries.name: Disengage
entries.text: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.text: Until your next turn: attack rolls against you have disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saves with advantage. You lose the benefit if incapacitated or your speed drops to 0.

entries.name: Help
entries.text: Give an ally advantage on their next ability check to do the task you're helping with, or on their next attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of you, made before your next turn.

entries.name: Hide
entries.text: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to become hidden.

entries.name: Ready
entries.text: Choose a trigger and an action (or movement). Use your reaction when the trigger occurs. Readying a spell requires concentration and casts it when released.

entries.name: Search
entries.text: Devote attention to finding something: usually Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation).

entries.name: Use an Object
entries.text: Interact with a second object on your turn, or use an object requiring an action.

entries.name: Grapple (special melee attack)
entries.text: Contest your Strength (Athletics) vs. the target's Athletics or Acrobatics. On a success the target is grappled (speed 0). Target must be no more than one size larger. Escape uses the target's action and the same contest.

entries.name: Shove (special melee attack)
entries.text: Same contest as a grapple. On a success, knock the target prone or push it 5 feet away.

entries.name: Opportunity Attack (reaction)
entries.text: When a hostile creature you can see moves out of your reach, use your reaction for one melee attack against it.

entries.name: Two-Weapon Fighting (bonus action)
entries.text: When you Attack with a light melee weapon in one hand, you can attack with a different light melee weapon in the other as a bonus action, without adding your ability modifier to the damage (unless negative).

entries.name: Half cover
entries.text: +2 to AC and Dexterity saving throws. An obstacle blocks at least half the body: a low wall, furniture, a creature, a thin tree.

entries.name: Three-quarters cover
entries.text: +5 to AC and Dexterity saving throws. About three-quarters covered: a portcullis, an arrow slit, a thick tree trunk.

entries.name: Total cover
entries.text: Can't be targeted directly by an attack or spell, though some spells reach it in an area of effect.

entries.name: Lightly obscured
entries.text: Dim light, patchy fog, moderate foliage. Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Heavily obscured
entries.text: Darkness, opaque fog, dense foliage. Vision is blocked entirely; a creature effectively suffers the blinded condition when looking into it.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries.text: Perceive surroundings without sight within a radius.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.text: Within range, treat dim light as bright light and darkness as dim light. Can't discern color in darkness.

entries.name: Truesight
entries.text: See in normal and magical darkness, see invisible creatures and objects, automatically detect visual illusions, perceive the original form of shapechangers, and see into the Ethereal Plane.

entries.name: Common light sources
entries.text: Torch: 20 ft bright / 20 ft dim, 1 hour. Lamp: 15/30, 6 hours. Hooded lantern: 30/30, 6 hours. Bullseye lantern: 60-ft cone/60, 6 hours. Candle: 5/5, 1 hour. Light spell: 20/20, 1 hour. Dancing Lights: 10-ft dim.

entries.name: Short rest
entries.text: At least 1 hour of light activity. Spend Hit Dice to heal: roll the die + Con modifier per die spent.

entries.name: Long rest
entries.text: At least 8 hours: sleep for at least 6 with no more than 2 hours of light activity. Regain all HP and half your total Hit Dice (minimum 1). Interrupted by 1+ hour of walking, fighting, casting, or similar. One long rest per 24 hours; must have at least 1 HP to benefit.

entries.name: Fast pace
entries.text: 400 ft/min, 4 miles/hour, 30 miles/day. Penalty: -5 to passive Wisdom (Perception).

entries.name: Normal pace
entries.text: 300 ft/min, 3 miles/hour, 24 miles/day.

entries.name: Slow pace
entries.text: 200 ft/min, 2 miles/hour, 18 miles/day. Able to use stealth.

entries.name: Forced march
entries.text: Beyond 8 hours/day: each extra hour, each creature makes a Con save (DC 10 + 1 per hour past 8) or takes one level of exhaustion.

entries.name: Difficult terrain
entries.text: Every foot costs 1 extra foot; travel at half speed.

entries.name: Mounts and vehicles
entries.text: A mount can gallop at double fast pace for about an hour. Water travel depends on the vessel and crew, and can go around the clock.

entries.name: Difficulty Classes
entries.text: Very easy 5, Easy 10, Medium 15, Hard 20, Very hard 25, Nearly impossible 30.

entries.name: Contests
entries.text: Both parties roll ability checks; higher result wins. Ties preserve the status quo.

entries.name: Working together
entries.text: One creature leads a group effort with advantage from a helper, if working together is actually plausible.

entries.name: Group checks
entries.text: Everyone rolls. If at least half succeed, the group succeeds.

entries.name: Passive checks
entries.text: 10 + all modifiers that normally apply. Advantage +5, disadvantage -5.

entries.name: Long jump
entries.text: With a 10-ft running start, jump up to your Strength score in feet. Standing: half that. Each foot costs a foot of movement.

entries.name: High jump
entries.text: With a 10-ft running start, jump 3 + Strength modifier feet up. Standing: half that. Reach is height x 1.5 during the jump.

entries.name: Climbing and swimming
entries.text: Each foot costs 1 extra foot (2 extra in difficult terrain) unless you have a climbing/swimming speed. A difficult climb or rough water may require Strength (Athletics) checks.

entries.name: Crawling
entries.text: Each foot costs 1 extra foot (2 extra in difficult terrain).

entries.name: Falling
entries.text: 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen, max 20d6. Land prone unless damage is avoided.

entries.name: Holding breath
entries.text: 1 + Con modifier minutes (minimum 30 seconds).

entries.name: Suffocating
entries.text: When out of breath, survive Con modifier rounds (minimum 1). At the start of the next turn, drop to 0 HP and start dying; no healing or stabilizing until you can breathe.

entries.name: Extreme cold
entries.text: At or below 0 F: DC 10 Con save at the end of each hour or gain one level of exhaustion. Cold resistance/immunity or appropriate gear negates.

entries.name: Extreme heat
entries.text: 100 F or above without water: Con save each hour (DC 5, +1 per additional hour) or gain one level of exhaustion. Disadvantage in heavy clothes or armor.

entries.name: Strong wind
entries.text: Disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls and hearing-based Perception; extinguishes open flames and disperses fog.

entries.name: Heavy precipitation
entries.text: Lightly obscures everything; disadvantage on sight-based Perception, and rain douses open flames.

entries.name: Frigid water
entries.text: Immersion: survive Con modifier minutes (min 1), then DC 10 Con save each additional minute or gain one level of exhaustion.

entries.name: Level 1
entries.text: Disadvantage on ability checks.

entries.name: Level 2
entries.text: Speed halved.

entries.name: Level 3
entries.text: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

entries.name: Level 4
entries.text: Hit point maximum halved.

entries.name: Level 5
entries.text: Speed reduced to 0.

entries.name: Level 6
entries.text: Death.

entries.name: Recovery
entries.text: Finishing a long rest with food and drink reduces exhaustion by 1 level.

entries.name: Mounting and dismounting
entries.text: Costs half your speed. The mount must be within 5 feet and at least one size larger than you.

entries.name: Controlled mount
entries.text: Acts on your initiative; can only Dash, Disengage, and Dodge. Moves as you direct.

entries.name: Independent mount
entries.text: Keeps its own initiative and acts freely (typical for intelligent mounts).

entries.name: Falling off
entries.text: If the mount is knocked prone, or an effect moves it or knocks you off, land prone within 5 feet, or make a DC 10 Dex save to stay mounted when it moves unexpectedly.

entries.name: Melee attacks
entries.text: Disadvantage on melee weapon attack rolls unless using a dagger, javelin, shortsword, spear, or trident (or the attacker has a swim speed).

entries.name: Ranged attacks
entries.text: Automatically miss beyond normal range. Within normal range, disadvantage unless using a crossbow, net, or thrown spear-like weapon (or swim speed).

entries.name: Fire
entries.text: Anything fully immersed has resistance to fire damage.

entries.name: Breaking concentration
entries.text: Casting another concentration spell ends the first. Taking damage: Con save DC 10 or half the damage taken, whichever is higher. Incapacitated or killed: concentration ends.

entries.name: Environmental effects
entries.text: The GM may call for a DC 10 Con save in situations like crashing waves or high winds.

entries.name: Instant death
entries.text: If damage reduces you to 0 HP and the remainder equals or exceeds your HP maximum, you die outright.

entries.name: Dropping to 0
entries.text: Fall unconscious and start making death saves at the start of your turns: d20, 10+ succeeds. Three successes stabilize, three failures kill. A natural 20 restores 1 HP; a natural 1 counts as two failures. Damage at 0 HP causes a failure (two on a crit).

entries.name: Stabilizing
entries.text: DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check as an action. A stable creature regains 1 HP after 1d4 hours.

entries.name: Knocking out
entries.text: When a melee attack drops a creature to 0 HP, the attacker can knock it out instead; it is unconscious and stable.

entries.name: Resistance and vulnerability
entries.text: Resistance halves damage of that type; vulnerability doubles it. Apply after other modifiers; multiple instances of resistance to the same type count once.

entries.name: Temporary hit points
entries.text: Not actual HP and don't stack: take the higher value. Lost first, can exceed your max, disappear per the granting effect or after a long rest.
